flashcards.title: DMV Flashcards - Set 2: Right-of-Way at Kaligtasan
flashcards.description: 15 mahahalagang tanong sa DMV tungkol sa right-of-way, kaligtasan, at mga tuntunin sa daan (Tagalog at Ingles).

cards.question: Sino ang may right-of-way sa isang interseksyon na walang crosswalk?
cards.answer: ang mga tao na naglalakad ay laging may right-of-way
cards.questionEn: Who has the right-of-way at an intersection with no crosswalks?

cards.question: Kung papalapit ka sa isang kurba o tuktok ng burol at wala kang malinaw na tanaw sa daan sa unahan, dapat kang:
cards.questionEn: If you approach a curve or the top of a hill and you do not have a clear view of the road ahead, you should:
cards.answerEn: slow down so you can stop if necessary

cards.question: Kaninong responsibilidad na malaman kung paano nakakaapekto ang iyong mga gamot sa iyong pagmamaneho?
cards.questionEn: Whose responsibility is it to know how your medications affect your driving?

cards.question: Alin sa mga sumusunod ang totoo tungkol sa safety belt at banggaan?
cards.answer: pinapataas nila ang iyong tsansa na mabuhay sa karamihan ng uri ng banggaan
cards.questionEn: Which of the following is true about safety belts and collisions?
cards.answerEn: they increase your chances of survival in most types of collisions

cards.question: Kung hindi mo makita ang daan sa unahan habang nagmamaneho dahil sa makapal na ulap-usok (fog) at hindi nakakatulong ang wiper, dapat kang:
cards.answer: tuluyang huminto sa gilid ng daan hanggang gumanda ang visibility
cards.questionEn: If you are unable to see the road ahead while driving because of heavy fog and your wipers do not help, you should:
cards.answerEn: pull off the road completely until visibility improves

cards.question: Ang pula at puting karatulang ito ay nangangahulugang:
cards.answer: hindi ka maaaring pumasok sa daan mula sa iyong direksyon
cards.questionEn: This red and white sign means:
cards.answerEn: you may not enter the road from your direction

cards.question: Kailangan mong magsuot ng safety belt sa isang gumagalaw na sasakyan:
cards.answer: at ang hindi pagsunod ay magreresulta sa traffic ticket
cards.questionEn: You are required to wear your safety belt in a moving vehicle:
cards.answerEn: and failure to do so will result in a traffic ticket

cards.question: Tumatawid ka sa isang interseksyon at may papalapit na emergency vehicle na may sirena at kumukurap na ilaw. Dapat kang:
cards.answer: gumilid sa kanan sa loob ng interseksyon at huminto
cards.questionEn: You are crossing an intersection and an emergency vehicle is approaching with a siren and flashing lights. You should:
cards.answerEn: pull to the right in the intersection and stop

cards.question: Nasa two-way na daan ka at ang sasakyan sa unahan mo ay lumiliko pakaliwa papasok sa isang driveway. Maaari kang legal na lumampas sa kanan:
cards.answer: kung may sapat na daan sa pagitan ng curb at ng sasakyan
cards.questionEn: You are on a two-way road and the vehicle ahead of you is turning left into a driveway. You may legally pass on the right:
cards.answerEn: if there is enough road between the curb and the vehicle

cards.question: Kung may green light ka, ngunit may trapikong humaharang sa interseksyon:
cards.answer: manatili sa labas ng interseksyon at maghintay hanggang lumuwag ang trapiko
cards.questionEn: If you have a green light, but traffic is blocking the intersection:
cards.answerEn: stay out of the intersection and wait until traffic clears

cards.question: Ang puting karatulang ito ay nangangahulugang:
cards.answer: tumingin, makinig, at maghandang huminto sa krosing kung kinakailangan
cards.answerEn: look, listen, and prepare to stop at the crossing, if necessary

cards.question: Aling pahayag ang totoo tungkol sa mga motorsiklista at motorista?
cards.answer: ang mga motorsiklista ay may parehong karapatan at responsibilidad gaya ng ibang motorista
cards.questionEn: Which statement is true about motorcyclists and motorists?
cards.answerEn: motorcyclists have the same rights/responsibilities as other motorists

cards.question: Kapag lumilipat ka o sumasanib sa ibang lane, ikaw ay:
cards.answer: nangangailangan ng hindi bababa sa 4-segundong puwang sa trapiko
cards.questionEn: When you change or merge with another lane, you:
cards.answerEn: need at least a 4-second gap in traffic

cards.question: Ang iyong mga gulong ay dapat nakaturo nang diretso sa unahan, maliban kung ikaw ay:
cards.answer: nakaparada sa burol o nakasalubong na driveway
cards.questionEn: Your wheels should be pointed straight ahead, unless you are:
cards.answerEn: parked on a hill or sloping driveway

cards.question: Nagmamaneho ka sa pinakakanang lane ng isang four-lane na freeway at napansin mo ang makapal na putol-putol na puting linya sa kaliwa ng iyong lane. Nagmamaneho ka sa:
cards.questionEn: You are driving in the far right lane of a four-lane freeway and notice thick broken white lines on the left side of your lane. You are driving in:
